name: Gengar (CobbleEffort form)
look: a squat orange body with a huge toothy grin, a black bat-winged mask with two yellow eyes and a third on its forehead, two red horns and a wild red-and-yellow flame mane
entry: Its third eye sees the souls of the living. On the hottest nights its mane of hellfire flares up, and it grins as it chases the shadows of travellers through the badlands.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in the Nether (or trade a CobbleEffortian Haunter).
